chunks: Have you seen him who turns his back,
ai.seo_question: Who is the person referred to in Surah An-Najm who turned his back on the message?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently linked to the incident of the Satanic Verses, where Al-Walid ibn al-Mughirah's arrogance led him to turn away from the revelation, serving as a divine correction. It underscores the spiritual consequence of pride and self-sufficiency, illustrating how those who reject the truth due to their own ego are ultimately left to their own devices without divine support.
